# Chapter 1: The Keeper

The keeper climbed the stairs every evening, counting the steps as her mother had taught her.
There were ninety-one, and she had never once reached the top with the number wrong.

## What She Carried

She carried three things up the tower:

- a can of oil for the lamp
- a cloth for the glass
- the *ledger*, in which she wrote the weather

> The sea keeps no records. Someone has to.

Her entries were short and **exact**. Wind from the north, a clear sky, nothing to report.

## Why It Mattered

A ledger is only useful if it is honest on the days when honesty is dull. She understood
this long before she understood anything else about the work.
